notes.title: RIDE THE WAVE 🌊 OF DINOPUNK: THE CACOPS ADVENTURE WITH DOJO SYSTEM!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716201/d57a28926fd6bba5bba628a739381dc09ca9d8d6.png[/img]

[h1]RIDE THE WAVE 🌊 OF DINOPUNK: THE CACOPS ADVENTURE WITH DOJO SYSTEM![/h1]

To all [b]#IndieDevs #GameDevs[/b] and lovers of [b]retro video games[/b],

Get ready for this epic Jurassic adventure with [b]🦖Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure[/b]!
From Dojo System🏯 and The Dude Games studio, we invite you to dive into a pixel art world full of action, challenging platforms, and a nostalgic vibe that will take you back to the 80s. You can now enjoy its revamped art and exclusive soundtrack while you become a small amphibian dinosaur with the unique power to control water.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44716201/23c094958a25b0a8b7d0c00a129e1e038096ef0d.png[/img]


Discover the story of Cacops and help him in his quest to recover his stolen egg🥚, while facing obstacles, enemies, and dinosaurs under the rule of the fearsome King-T. With pixel art aesthetics paying homage to classics like Wonder Boy, Alex Kidd, and Contra, Dinopunk captures the essence of 2D platformers from the golden era, but with updated graphics and more modern gameplay.

Explore a vast map full of secrets and challenging levels, using your ability to control water. You can also upgrade your skills in the in-game store, unlocking new abilities to tackle increasingly difficult levels.

And that's not all! Dinopunk: The Cacops Adventure also includes a minigame, in true California Games🏄 style, and countless nods to the 90s and 80s. Don't forget the epic battles against gigantic final bosses, each with their own unique attack style and patterns.

Enjoy the new trailer and this retro 🕹️ modern experience for all audiences.
